lin.zh: 你好呀！今天过得怎么样？
lin.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo ya! Jīntiān guò de zěnmeyàng?
lin.en: Hello there! How is your day going?
lin.speaker: lin

mei.zh: 你好！很高兴又见到你。一起看看今天的词吧！
mei.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng yòu jiàn dào nǐ. Yìqǐ kànkan jīntiān de cí ba!
mei.en: Hello! It's lovely to see you again. Let's look at today's words!
mei.speaker: mei

mei-first.zh: 你好！我叫小美。我们一起认识四个词吧！
mei-first.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Xiǎoměi. Wǒmen yìqǐ rènshi sì ge cí ba!
mei-first.en: Hello! I'm Xiaomei. Let's learn four words together!
mei-first.speaker: mei

chen.zh: 你好啊！随便看看，有喜欢的就跟我说。
chen.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo a! Suíbiàn kànkan, yǒu xǐhuan de jiù gēn wǒ shuō.
chen.en: Hi! Have a look around. Let me know if anything catches your eye.
chen.speaker: chen

friend-a.en: Hi! Out for a little walk?
friend-a.speaker: friend-a

friend-b.zh: 你好呀！在这儿休息一会儿吧。
friend-b.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo ya! Zài zhèr xiūxi yíhuìr ba.
friend-b.en: Hello there! Take a little break here.
friend-b.speaker: friend-b

default.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng jiàn dào nǐ.
default.speaker: friend-a

staff.zh: 你好！欢迎光临。请坐，慢慢看。
staff.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Huānyíng guānglín. Qǐng zuò, mànman kàn.
staff.en: Hello! Welcome. Please sit and take your time looking.
staff.speaker: cook

tea-question.zh: 我今天在茶铺坐了一会儿，喝了一杯茶。那里很安静，坐着看看书也不错。你平时喜欢喝茶吗？
tea-question.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zài chápù zuò le yíhuìr, hē le yì bēi chá. Nàli hěn ānjìng, zuòzhe kànkan shū yě búcuò. Nǐ píngshí xǐhuan hē chá ma?
tea-question.en: I spent a little time at the tea shop today and had a cup of tea. It's quiet there, a nice place to sit and read, too. Do you usually like drinking tea?
tea-question.speaker: friend-a
tea-question.hint: Tell them your preference: 喜欢, 不太喜欢, or 有时候喝. This is optional stretch practice, with some new linking phrases.

tea-reply.zh: 每个人喜欢的都不一样。逛累了，就找个地方坐坐，慢慢来。
tea-reply.pinyin: Měi ge rén xǐhuan de dōu bù yíyàng. Guàng lèi le, jiù zhǎo ge dìfang zuòzuo, mànman lái.
tea-reply.en: Everyone has different tastes. When you get tired of walking, find somewhere to sit. Take your time.
tea-reply.speaker: friend-a

book-question.zh: 我最近在看一本故事书。每天晚上看几页，不着急看完。你喜欢看书，还是喜欢出去走走？
book-question.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn zài kàn yì běn gùshi shū. Měitiān wǎnshang kàn jǐ yè, bù zháojí kàn wán. Nǐ xǐhuan kàn shū, háishi xǐhuan chūqù zǒuzou?
book-question.en: I've been reading a storybook, a few pages every evening. I'm in no hurry to finish. Do you prefer reading or going out for a walk?
book-question.speaker: friend-a
book-question.hint: You can choose either activity, both (都喜欢), or say it depends (看情况).

book-reply.zh: 有空做点自己喜欢的事，挺好的。今天也别太忙，好好休息一下。
book-reply.pinyin: Yǒu kòng zuò diǎn zìjǐ xǐhuan de shì, tǐng hǎo de. Jīntiān yě bié tài máng, hǎohāo xiūxi yíxià.
book-reply.en: It's nice to make time for things you enjoy. Don't keep too busy today. Have a good rest.
book-reply.speaker: friend-a

apple-question.zh: 我刚买了几个苹果，准备带回家。水果店就在前面，走几步就到了。你喜欢吃苹果吗？
apple-question.pinyin: Wǒ gāng mǎi le jǐ ge píngguǒ, zhǔnbèi dài huí jiā. Shuǐguǒ diàn jiù zài qiánmiàn, zǒu jǐ bù jiù dào le. Nǐ xǐhuan chī píngguǒ ma?
apple-question.en: I just bought a few apples to take home. The fruit shop is up ahead, only a few steps away. Do you like apples?
apple-question.speaker: friend-a
apple-question.hint: A short preference is enough: 喜欢, 还可以, or 不太喜欢.

apple-reply.zh: 有喜欢吃的就买一点儿，不用买太多。新鲜的最好吃。
apple-reply.pinyin: Yǒu xǐhuan chī de jiù mǎi yìdiǎnr, búyòng mǎi tài duō. Xīnxiān de zuì hǎochī.
apple-reply.en: Buy a little of whatever you enjoy. No need to buy too much. Fresh is best.
apple-reply.speaker: friend-a

water-question.zh: 我出来走路，总会带一瓶水。走累了就坐下来喝几口，再慢慢往前走。你今天带水了吗？
water-question.pinyin: Wǒ chūlái zǒulù, zǒng huì dài yì píng shuǐ. Zǒu lèi le jiù zuò xiàlái hē jǐ kǒu, zài mànman wǎng qián zǒu. Nǐ jīntiān dài shuǐ le ma?
water-question.en: I always bring a bottle of water when I go walking. When I get tired, I sit down for a few sips before continuing. Did you bring water today?
water-question.speaker: friend-a
water-question.hint: Answer 带了 (I brought some) or 没带 (I didn't), or say you plan to buy water.

water-reply.zh: 路上记得喝水，别走得太急。出来玩，舒服最重要。
water-reply.pinyin: Lùshang jìde hē shuǐ, bié zǒu de tài jí. Chūlái wán, shūfu zuì zhòngyào.
water-reply.en: Remember to drink water along the way, and don't rush. When you're out enjoying yourself, being comfortable matters most.
water-reply.speaker: friend-a
